_comment: Synthetic, hand-written Black Duck Rapid-Scan-style JSON fixture for Reachlayer's connector tests. NOT a real Black Duck export - no vendor data is redistributed here (see PLAN.md §9 risk 6). Simplified relative to the real BDIO JSON-LD graph format for MVP readability; see docs/connectors.md.

vulnerabilities.description: Remote code execution via JNDI lookup in the logging library (Log4Shell).
Denial of service via a crafted 7z archive that expands to consume excessive memory.
Polymorphic type handling flaw allowing deserialization gadget chains.
